name: 603 Auto Salvage - Quality Used Parts & Cash For Cars
old_description: I’m a retail customer or a commercial shop and I’m looking to buy quality used auto parts at affordable prices.
about:
603 Auto Salvage operates from Plaistow, New Hampshire, where it runs an auto salvage yard and retail parts business. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business specializes in supplying OEM used auto parts to both retail customers and commercial repair shops. Its inventory is searchable via an online stock-check tool, and the company advertises next-day service for parts fulfillment. The yard also purchases end-of-life vehicles for salvage, offering cash for cars.

Customers include individual vehicle owners and professional automotive shops seeking affordable replacement components. The company positions its parts as a cost-effective alternative to new OEM parts, with a focus on quality and fitment assurance, and indicates that its inventory includes a variety of options to suit different preferences and budgets.

603 Auto Salvage emphasizes a clean, organized yard and knowledgeable staff as part of its service approach, though specific certifications or unique founding motivations are not detailed in available sources.
